title: ensures Basics
concept: The ensures clause declares what the function guarantees about its return value or side effects after execution.
why: ensures transforms your function's promises from comments into machine-checked guarantees — catching logic bugs before they propagate.
tips: result is only valid inside ensures — don't try to use it in the function body
Use multiple simple ensures instead of one complex one — easier to debug
param@pre lets you verify state changes — essential for mutable parameter contracts
If an ensures fails, the bug is in YOUR function, not the caller
common_mistakes: Writing ensures: x > 0 when you meant ensures: result > 0
Forgetting that ensures is checked AFTER the function returns
